name: mount
summary: List the sources mounted into the machine, show their pending changes, or list them again
help: List the sources the host has mounted into the machine, one per line with its mode and what it can't do.
-r, --refresh   list each DIR's source again (every mount without DIR)
-c, --changes   show the changes waiting in each staged or live DIR (every mount without DIR)
-d, --discard   drop your changes in each DIR: its files are the source's again
The host application decides what happens to the changes: nothing (ro), applied when it reviews them

options.description: list the source of each DIR again
show the changes waiting in each DIR
drop your changes in each DIR

messages.notFetched: not fetched from the mounted source yet (run the command again)
messages.notListed: not listed from the mounted source yet (run the command again)
messages.progress: fetched {count} of {total} files under {dir} before the time limit; run the command again to continue
messages.removed: its mount was removed before it was fetched
messages.notBytes: the source returned something other than bytes
messages.notListedYet: the mount is not listed yet
messages.held: {count} changes from a saved session wait for the host
messages.conflict: {path}: changed in the source since it was read; the change stays pending (mount --discard {dir} drops your changes)
messages.failed: {path}: {reason}; the change stays pending (mount --discard {dir} drops your changes)
messages.timedOut: the source did not answer in time
messages.skipped: {dir}: skipped {count} entries with names that can't be files
messages.replay: {op} {path} is not in the Topwater recording

notes: Topwater's own command: real mount lists kernel filesystems. The listing uses the same 'SOURCE on DIR type TYPE (OPTIONS)' shape.
